## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the behaviour change (or explain why none is needed).
- [ ] `mise run check` passes locally.
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`, DCO).
- [ ] User-facing docs are updated in English **and** Spanish (`X.md` and
      `X.es.md`, with the `<!-- source -->` header bumped), or not affected.
- [ ] No new dependency, or it is justified under "What and why" and its
      version is at least 3 days old.
